title: India advises nationals in France to stay alert amid protests, curfews
description:
India has advised its nationals living in France and those travelling to the country to remain vigilant and exercise caution amid continuing unrest, violent clashes and localised curfews in parts of the European nation.
In an advisory issued on Wednesday, the Embassy of India in France urged Indian nationals to avoid large gatherings and crowded places where protests are taking place and follow instructions issued by local authorities.
"In view of the recent developments and localised curfews imposed in France, please remain vigilant and exercise due caution," it said.
The advisory comes as France grapples with widespread protests and riots, triggered by student demonstrations over high school conditions and expanding into mass anti-government anger over inflation and living costs. The unrest has been marked by incidents of looting, arson and clashes between demonstrators and police.
The Indian mission asked nationals to stay informed through local news reports and official updates
